Summary: Forus is an AI-powered platform embedded into EHR workflows that automates prior authorizations, appeals, financial assistance, and pharmacy routing. It takes prescription and patient information as input to provide comprehensive support for medication access. The platform's role is to accelerate time to therapy and ensure patients receive their prescribed treatments.
